## Patterns
| Keyword | Description | Example |
|---------|-------------|---------|
| `versioned-enum` | Core types use versioned enums (V0, V1, ...) with accessor traits for forward compatibility | `DataContract::V0(DataContractV0)`, `DataContract::V1(DataContractV1)` |
| `accessor-traits` | Getter/setter traits (V0Getters, V0Setters, V1Getters) implemented on versioned enums for uniform API | `DataContractV0Getters::id()`, `DataContractV1Getters::groups()` |
| `platform-versioning` | All operations take `&PlatformVersion` to select correct code paths and serialization formats | `DataContract::versioned_deserialize(data, true, platform_version)` |
| `change-control-rules` | Token features use ChangeControlRules with AuthorizedActionTakers for fine-grained governance | `manual_minting_rules: ChangeControlRules` with `AuthorizedActionTakers::ContractOwner` |
| `group-multiparty` | Groups enable multiparty authorization: members with power values, required_power threshold | Group with 3 members, each power=1, required_power=2 for 2-of-3 multisig |
| `batch-transition` | Documents and tokens use BatchTransition to combine multiple operations in a single state transition | `BatchTransition::V1(BatchTransitionV1 { transitions: vec![...] })` |
| `token-id-derivation` | Token IDs are deterministic: `hash_double("dash_token" \|\| contract_id \|\| token_pos.to_be_bytes())` | `calculate_token_id(&contract_id, 0)` |
| `contested-index` | Unique indexes can be contested with field match patterns and MasternodeVote resolution | `contested: { fieldMatches: [{ field: "name", regexPattern: "^[a-z]" }], resolution: 0 }` |
| `document-timestamps` | Documents can track created_at, updated_at, transferred_at at ms, block_height, core_block_height levels | `DocumentV0 { created_at: Some(ts), created_at_block_height: Some(h), ... }` |
| `contract-schema-defs` | Contracts support shared `$defs` subschemas reusable across document types | `schema_defs: Some(BTreeMap { "address" => { ... } })` |
| `token-keeps-history` | TokenKeepsHistoryRules controls which events are recorded as historical documents | `keeps_transfer_history: true, keeps_minting_history: true` |
| `token-distribution` | Tokens support both perpetual (ongoing rewards) and pre-programmed (scheduled) distributions | `distribution_rules.perpetual_distributions`, `distribution_rules.pre_programmed_distributions` |
| `token-marketplace` | TokenMarketplaceRules configures direct purchase and trading for tokens | `marketplace_rules: TokenMarketplaceRules::V0(TokenMarketplaceRulesV0 { ... })` |
| `wasm-bindings` | Rust types wrapped with `#[wasm_bindgen]` in wasm-dpp for JS/TS interop | `DataContractFacadeWasm`, `DataContractCreateTransitionWasm` |
| `document-property-types` | JSON Schema types map to Rust: string->String, integer->I64/U64/sized, boolean->Boolean, array->Array, object->Object | `"type": "string", "maxLength": 50` -> `DocumentPropertyType::String(StringPropertySizes { max_length: Some(50) })` |
| `nft-trading` | Documents support NFT trading via Transferable enum and TradeMode (DirectPurchase) | `documents_transferable: Transferable::Always, trade_mode: TradeMode::DirectPurchase` |
| `creation-restriction` | Document types can restrict creation: NoRestrictions, OwnerOnly, NoCreationAllowed | `creation_restriction_mode: CreationRestrictionMode::OwnerOnly` |
| `system-contracts` | Platform defines system contracts (DPNS, Dashpay, etc.) loaded via load_system_data_contract() | `load_system_data_contract(SystemDataContract::DPNS, platform_version)` |
| `evo-sdk-trusted` | dash-bridge uses EvoSDK.testnetTrusted()/mainnetTrusted() for operations requiring quorum verification | `const sdk = EvoSDK.testnetTrusted(); await sdk.connect();` |
| `identity-signer` | Identity operations use IdentitySigner to collect WIF-encoded private keys for signing | `const signer = new IdentitySigner(); signer.addKeyFromWif(wif);` |
| `dpns-homograph` | DPNS normalizes labels for homograph safety: o->0, i/l->1; contested if 3-19 chars with [a-z01-] | `convertToHomographSafe("alice") -> "a11ce"` |
| `token-encrypted-notes` | Token transfers support public, shared-encrypted, and personal-encrypted notes | `Transfer(recipient, public_note, shared_note, personal_note, amount)` |
| `token-emergency` | TokenEmergencyAction::Pause/Resume controls token operational status via emergency_action_rules | `TokenEmergencyAction::Pause -> TokenStatus { paused: true }` |
| `group-action-event` | Group actions wrap TokenEvents, enabling multiparty authorization for token operations | `GroupActionEvent::TokenEvent(TokenEvent::Mint(...))` |
| `token-config-change` | TokenConfigurationChangeItem enum covers all mutable aspects of token config | `ConfigUpdate(TokenConfigurationChangeItem::..., public_note)` |
| `document-type-token-costs` | V1 document types can charge token costs per CRUD action | `set_document_creation_token_cost(Some(DocumentActionTokenCost { ... }))` |
